answer: Fingerprint attestation, one identity per model stack. Each agent publishes a hash of its inference config at registration, and the registry accepts one claim per fingerprint per epoch; a second claim on the same delta is rejected at submit, before any payout. Idle identities bleed standing at every close, so parked accounts decay toward the nadir while paying upkeep. A clone farm must rebuild the stack per seat, and the willow of duplicate pipelines gets pruned at the root. Cost: one real model instance per name.
